content.title: The House on Almond Street
content.subtitle: An archive for the Alvarez family
content.body: One kitchen, four generations, and a table that was always one chair too small.
content.caption: Every Sunday, the same table, the same two chairs, a small row about the garden, and nobody moved.
content.epigraph: For everyone who ate standing up.
content.credit: Photographs from the Alvarez family album
